notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements the core WORLDTEXTSTRING observables: floating text is world-anchored over the recipient at overhead height, capped at 4 concurrent per unit as a hard drop (MaxWorldTextPerUnit), self-source-only (Gate A: only the local player's outgoing damage floats; another unit's fight floats nothing), miss/dodge/parry/block/absorb/resist words, the melee-white vs spell-gold color split, crit flagged, and the XP text self-anchored. Heals never float over the world (matching 5875).

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: MSUI additionally shows center-screen incoming damage/heal/power text for the self player; 5875 has no center scrolling combat text (that feedback was portrait-flash only, which MSUI also has). An addition, not a parity gap.
